verdict.rationale: Martin's docs clearly show first-party integrations for calendar (read/create/update events) and email/inbox (read/draft/reply), plus a generic 'search engines' capability, matching most of the story. However, there is no explicit evidence of a cloud-drive connector (e.g., Google Drive, Dropbox) being searchable/usable by the assistant, so the 'cloud drive' portion of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: explicit cloud-drive/file-storage integration, independent verification that search actually indexes connected drive content.
